name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Har Khet Ko Pani (Groundwater Irrigation Scheme) Uttarakhand
benefit: Under the scheme, farmers are provided with free irrigation facilities. Collective irrigation projects or individual groundwater irrigation projects are constructed. The works carried out under the scheme include: - Solar-powered pumpsets - Electrically operated pumpsets
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. As per the guidelines issued by the Government of India: - For the construction of collective irrigation projects, a command area of 5 hectares must be available. - According to the report of the Central Ground Water Board, Government of India, the command area must be classified under the safe category.
